name: graph-first-artifact-class-shrink
body: The graph-first artifact classes are: the in-graph set, which is every tracked text/config/packaging file the scanner claims (`Cargo.toml`/`Cargo.lock`, `go.mod`/`go.sum`, `package.json`/`package-lock.json`, `*.csproj`, `Formula/*.rb`, `install.sh`, `.cargo/config.toml`, `.github/**`, Markdown and the other structural streams); and the out-of-graph set, which means zero symbols rather than zero node. Ruby sources (`Formula/*.rb`, pending `apg-ruby`) and binaries have zero frontend, so they appear as residual `misc` `File` nodes carrying zero Module/Struct/Function facts; only paths the config scope and the standard exclusions remove have zero node at all. `solution.component.repo-agent-guide` (AGENTS.md) and `solution.component.navigator-prompt-guidance` (`opencode-suite/agents/codebase-navigator.md`) carry the same boundary text.
